ns2:section.sectionText: Information Theory for Operations Research. This course provides an introduction to information-theoretic approaches to addressing problems in operations research, with a focus on universal schemes for decision (or prediction), gambling, and portfolio selection. Application of such approaches are in aggregation of expert opinions where the expert opinions concern the prediction of the outcome of an uncertain event, universal schemes for sequential investment in stock market, etc. Apart from students in IESE, this course would be of interest to students from math, ECE, computer science, economics, and finance. No prior background in information theory is necessary. Prerequisites: One of MATH 464, MATH 564, ECE 534 or consent of instructor.
